label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/ssrf): alert-TP — resolved sink value is http://<user-hostname>/api constructed from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest"). The SSRF check using isNonPublicAddress(resolveHost(host)) only blocks well-known private addresses (loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local), but does not prevent connections to external/internal hosts discovered via DNS. Attacker-controlled host parameter flows directly to the URL construction at line 44 without proper authorization or allowlist validation, enabling potential SSRF to internal services.

evidence.note: User input param flows to host variable without sanitization
Sink: new java.net.URL("http://" + host).openConnection().connect() uses unvalidated host parameter
isNonPublicAddress only checks standard private address types, allowing many attack vectors
